title: Cookie Policy
subtitle: We believe in radical transparency regarding cookies and browser storage technologies.
tldr_content: We use zero advertising or invasive marketing tracking cookies. We only use functional browser localStorage for your resume drafts, and anonymous Google Analytics 4 cookies to monitor site uptime and performance.

sections.title: 1. What Are Cookies & Local Storage?
sections.content: Cookies and local storage are small text files placed on your device by websites you visit. They allow web applications to remember your preferences and session state across page reloads.

sections.title: 2. Cookies We Use
sections.content: Google Analytics 4 uses cookies (_ga and _ga_*) to distinguish unique visitors and measure overall website traffic trends. These cookies do not contain any resume data.

sections.title: 3. How to Disable Cookies
sections.content: You can control and disable cookies through your browser settings at any time without losing the ability to use the ResumeForge editor.
